title: Domino Chain Reaction with Particle Effects
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a Three.js scene showing a domino chain reaction with varied spacing and particle effects. Use Three.js from CDN and GLTFLoader.

## Scene Setup
- Dark gray background (0x1a1a2e). PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 18) looking at (0, 0, -5).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8 and castShadow enabled.
- A ground plane (50x50) with color 0x2d2d44, receiveShadow, at y=0.
- Enable shadow mapping on the renderer.

## Domino Chain
- Create exactly 12 dominoes arranged in a curved path. Each domino is a BoxGeometry(0.3, 1.5, 0.8) with color 0xf0f0f0 and castShadow.
- Dominoes are spaced with VARIED distances: first 4 dominoes spaced 1.0 unit apart, next 4 spaced 1.3 units apart, last 4 spaced 1.6 units apart.
- Arrange them along the x-axis starting at x = -8. Each domino stands upright on the ground (y = 0.75).
- Implement simple physics: each domino can tip forward. When a domino's rotation around z-axis exceeds 0.3 radians, it triggers the next domino to start falling (after a small delay based on spacing). Falling dominoes rotate from 0 to ~Math.PI/2 (1.57 rad) around their base.

## Avocado Trophy
- Load 'Avocado.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at the END of the domino chain (after the last domino, about 2 units further). Scale it to 30x (it's a small model). Position it on a small pedestal (CylinderGeometry 0.5, 0.5, 0.3) colored gold (0xffd700). The avocado sits at y = 0.5 on the pedestal. When the last domino falls, the avocado should start spinning (rotate around y-axis at 2 rad/s) and a burst of particles appears.

## Particle System
- Create a particle system using Points with 200 particles, initially invisible.
- When a domino falls and hits the next one, spawn a small burst of 10 particles at the contact point (color 0xff6600, size 0.1) that fade out over 0.5 seconds.
- When the last domino falls and triggers the avocado, spawn ALL 200 particles around the avocado in a celebratory explosion (colors: mix of 0xff0000, 0x00ff00, 0x0000ff, 0xffff00) that expand outward and fade over 2 seconds.

## User Interactions
- A 'Push First Domino' button (id='startBtn') at top-center of screen. Clicking it starts the chain reaction by applying a forward tilt to domino index 0.
- A 'Reset' button (id='resetBtn') next to it that resets all dominoes to upright, stops avocado spin, and hides particles.
- Press 'C' key to toggle camera between default position and a top-down view at (0, 20, 0) looking down.
- Press 'S' key to toggle slow motion (0.25x speed vs 1x speed).

## HUD
- Display 'Dominoes Fallen: X/12' (id='dominoCount') at top-left.
- Display 'Chain Complete!' (id='chainStatus') when all 12 have fallen, hidden otherwise.
- Display 'Speed: Normal' or 'Speed: Slow' (id='speedDisplay') at top-right.

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__:
- `dominoesFallen`: number (0-12) of dominoes that have fully fallen (rotation >= 1.4 rad)
- `chainStarted`: boolean, true after start button clicked
- `chainComplete`: boolean, true when all 12 dominoes fallen
- `avocadoSpinning`: boolean, true when avocado is spinning
- `particlesActive`: boolean, true when celebration particles are visible
- `cameraMode`: string, 'default' or 'topdown'
- `speedMultiplier`: number, 1.0 or 0.25
- `avocadoLoaded`: boolean, true when GLB model loaded
- `dominoRotations`: array of 12 numbers (current z-rotation of each domino in radians)
- `totalParticlesSpawned`: number tracking cumulative particles spawned
- `isReset`: boolean, true initially and after reset, false after chain starts
physics_constraints: Dominoes fall sequentially - each triggers the next when its rotation exceeds 0.3 rad threshold. Fall speed should respect spacing (further apart = slightly longer delay). Dominoes rotate around their base (bottom edge), not center. Angular velocity of falling domino approximately 2.5 rad/s at normal speed. No domino should pass through the ground plane. Avocado only activates after domino 12 falls.
